races.narrative:

Tasever will likely lead with Roger Henry pressing, creating a contested early pace with 6 prominent runners in a 9-horse field. This congestion up front should create a true pace over 1m, potentially setting up the race for the 5 confirmed hold-up horses. Traffic will be minimal given the small field size, favoring closers.

## TOP RATED

Roger Henry tops the projections despite his prominent style typically working against him in contested pace scenarios. His excellent going record (5 places from 9 runs) on similar ground compensates, though he's never finished strongly in 11 career runs.

## KEY DANGERS

**Dream Illusion** - Confirmed hold-up horse with strong going form (3 wins, 7 places from 12 runs) who should benefit from the expected strong pace. **Bajan Bandit** - Prominent runner with solid going record who could position perfectly if the pace collapses. **Barleybrown** - Pure hold-up horse with decent going form who needs the pace to be truly run.

## VERDICT

Dream Illusion offers the best combination of style advantage and going form. The contested early pace should perfectly suit his confirmed hold-up style, while his 3 wins from 12 runs on similar going demonstrates genuine ability on good ground. His hold-up style is ideally suited to exploit the expected pace scenario.

The pace will suit his patient approach, allowing him to dictate terms before the late kick. His poor going record remains the main worry, but class advantage should prove decisive against this modest field.
